verdict.rationale: Attio documents an official MCP server and AI tool connections that can "search, update and manage" the workspace. Its REST API reads and writes workspace data, and a Deal object exists. Native AI also picks up call signals and can "update records, schedule next steps," but nothing shows deal-stage updates driven by email or meeting signals through the API or MCP. missing for 10: documented deal stage attribute updates via API/MCP, API/MCP access to email and meeting/call signal data, an end-to-end agent example of stage/next-step updates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent update deal stages and next steps from email and meeting signals via the API or MCP server

citations.quote: Connect Claude, ChatGPT or your AI tool of choice to search, update and manage your Attio workspace.
official MCP server documented at https://attio.com/mcp
This allows developers to build apps that read and write information to and from Attio workspaces.
An object to represent deals involving people & companies
Draft follow-ups, update records, schedule next steps, create account briefs.
AI picks up buying signals, blockers, or requests during the call, not days later.
